robot arm starts cooking a meal at some.desc: This action enables a robot arm to begin cooking a meal at a location if the meal is not yet prepared. For example, if the arm is at kitchen_1 and meal_1 is unprepared, the robot arm can start cooking meal_1 at kitchen_1.
robot arm starts cooking a meal at some.abstract_desc: This action enables a robot arm to begin cooking [object1] at [position1] if [object1] is [state1].

robot arm finishes cooking a meal at som.desc: This action enables a robot arm to finish cooking a meal that it has started cooking. The meal becomes prepared and is available for picking up at the location. For example, if arm_1 is cooking meal_1 at kitchen_1, it can finish cooking and meal_1 becomes prepared and present at kitchen_1.
robot arm finishes cooking a meal at som.abstract_desc: This action enables a robot arm to finish cooking [object1]. [object1] becomes [state1] and available at [position1].

uav flies from one location to another.desc: This action enables the UAV to fly from one location to another. For example, the UAV can fly from kitchen_1 to location_1.
uav flies from one location to another.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to move from [position1] to [position2].

uav picks up a prepared meal at a locati.desc: This action enables the UAV to pick up a prepared meal at a location, if the UAV is empty. For example, if the UAV is at kitchen_1, meal_1 is prepared and located there, and the UAV is empty, it can pick up meal_1.
uav picks up a prepared meal at a locati.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to load [object1] at [position1] if the uav is [state1] and [object1] is [state2].

uav delivers a meal to a location.desc: This action enables the UAV to deliver a carried meal to some location. After delivery, the UAV becomes empty again. For example, if the UAV is carrying meal_1 and is at location_1, it can deliver the meal there.
uav delivers a meal to a location.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to unload [object1] to [position1]. After this, the uav becomes [state1].
